definitions.gloss: investigation; thorough inquiry; getting to the bottom of
definitions.explanation: The act of thoroughly investigating and clarifying the truth or cause of something, especially accidents, incidents, or problems.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}を{究明|きゅうめい}する。
examples.english: To investigate the cause of the accident.

examples.japanese: {真相|しんそう}{究明|きゅうめい}を{求|もと}める{声|こえ}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: Calls for getting to the bottom of the truth are growing louder.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}チームが{原因|げんいん}{究明|きゅうめい}にあたっている。
examples.english: A team of experts is working on investigating the cause.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word often used in news and official reports. Combines {究|きゅう} (to investigate thoroughly) and {明|めい} (to clarify). Commonly paired with {原因|げんいん} (cause) or {真相|しんそう} (truth) to express the goal of the investigation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原因|げんいん}{究明|きゅうめい} (investigation of the cause)
- {真相|しんそう}{究明|きゅうめい} (getting to the truth)
- {事実|じじつ}{究明|きゅうめい} (fact-finding)
- {究明|きゅうめい}にあたる (to work on investigating)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調査|ちょうさ}: investigation, survey — broader, more neutral
- {解明|かいめい}: elucidation, clarification — similar but emphasizes making clear
- {捜査|そうさ}: criminal investigation — specifically by police or authorities
